definitions.gloss: auspicious day; lucky day; favorable day
definitions.explanation: A day considered to be fortunate or propitious for important events such as weddings, business openings, or moving house. Based on the traditional Japanese calendar system that designates certain days as lucky or unlucky.

examples.japanese: {良日|りょうじつ}を{選|えら}んで{結婚式|けっこんしき}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: We chose an auspicious day to hold the wedding.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}の{良日|りょうじつ}に{新|あたら}しい{店|みせ}を{開|ひら}く{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: We plan to open the new shop on an auspicious day next month.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{日程|にってい}は{良日|りょうじつ}にこだわる{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いため、{大安|たいあん}の{日|ひ}は{引越|ひっこし}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}の{予約|よやく}が{取|と}りにくい。
examples.english: Many people insist on moving on an auspicious day, so it is hard to book a moving company on taian days.

notes:
Refers to a day considered favorable for important events, based on the traditional {六曜|ろくよう} calendar system. The most commonly referenced auspicious day is {大安|たいあん}, which is considered lucky for all activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良日|りょうじつ}を{選|えら}ぶ: choose an auspicious day
- {良日|りょうじつ}を{待|ま}つ: wait for an auspicious day
- {吉|きち}{良日|りょうじつ}: lucky and auspicious day (emphatic form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {吉日|きちじつ}: lucky day (synonymous, slightly more common)
- {大安|たいあん}: taian, the most auspicious of the six calendar labels
- {日柄|ひがら}: the fortune of the day according to the traditional calendar

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese people still consult the {六曜|ろくよう} system when scheduling weddings, funerals, business openings, and other important events. Wedding venues and moving companies often charge premium rates on {大安|たいあん} days due to high demand.
